Guidance & outlook: Aavkar Hall (SBI BANK) Water Tank Road, Karelibaug, Vadodara - 390018 Gujarat, India. +91 7359315665 desaidipalics@gmail.com RICHA INFO SYSTEMS LIMITED 16th Annual Report 2025-26 Message to Stakeholders Dear Shareholders and Stakeholders, It gives me immense pleasure to present the 16th Annual Report of Richa Info Systems Limited for FY 2025 -26.

Strong Financial Performance FY 2025-26 was a year of strong growth for your Company. • Total Revenue: ₹14,283.72 lakh, compared with ₹12,772.89 lakh in FY 2024-25. • Profit Before Tax: ₹1,001.85 lakh, compared with ₹716.38 lakh in FY 2024-25. • Profit After Tax: ₹748.09 lakh, compared with ₹523.80 lakh in FY 2024-25.

These statements are based on the Company's current expectations and assumptions and are subject to various risks, uncertainties and other factors that may cause actual results, performance or achievements to differ materially from those anticipated.
Growth & demand: The strong improvement in profitability reflects the continued growth of our business and the increasing contribution from both our Electronics and Information Technology divisions.
We are committed to profitable growth, innovation, strong corporate governance and sustainable value creation.

While the technology landscape remains dynamic and competitive, we are confident that our diversified portfolio, customer relationships and experienced team provide a strong foundation for the next phase of our growth.
